summary: Frontend-only test of Hindi mode (i18n dictionary + LangToggle) on /kundli, /kundli/match, /horoscope at 1920 and 390px. Core feature works: toggle persists in localStorage nv:lang across reload/pages, html[lang]=hi, Kundli (Lagna तुला 4°27′, चंद्र राशि वृषभ, रोहिणी पद 3, गुरु / शुक्र), planet table, North chart abbreviations + लग्न, South chart Hindi sign names + राशि/नवांश center, Panchang (कृष्ण दशमी, बुधवार, व्याघात, वणिज, सूर्योदय 05:31), Manglik Hindi sentences, Dasha panel with Hindi month names, form labels/errors in Hindi. Match: 18/36 मध्यम मिलान, all 8 kootas and details (सर्प / वानर, मनुष्य / देव ...), cards, steps, buttons in Hindi. Horoscope: chips Hindi + English below, day tabs, tone badges, category titles, calculated text, Why lines, transits, method, disclaimer in Hindi; AI note shown once (overview only). Switching to English restores all text (only 'हिन्दी' toggle label remains). No horizontal overflow at 390px. A few small leftovers found (below).

issues: The center label uses tracking-[0.14em] (letter-spacing 1.82px), so the Hindi 'नवांश' / 'राशि' shows with gaps between letters ('न वां श'). Drop the tracking when lang==='hi'
Kundli 'पद्धति:' line: the method text from the backend stays English ('Sidereal zodiac, Lahiri ayanamsa (23.72°), Whole sign houses, Mean node, JPL DE421 ephemeris')
PlaceSearch empty state 'No city in the offline list.' is not wrapped in t()
Loading text 'Reading the transits' (Horoscope) and any Kundli loading/error text are not wrapped in t()

Ordinal numbers like '1वें', '2वें', '3वें', '4वें', '6वें भाव' are not correct Hindi (should be पहले/दूसरे/तीसरे/चौथे/छठे) or use 'भाव 3'. Shows in Horoscope Why lines, Moon-house sentence and Manglik sentence
A Latin '.' is used where Hindi needs '।': Manglik 'निरस्ति: मंगल अपनी राशि में है.', match doshas 'नाड़ी दोष, भकूट दोष.', and the match footer after 'परामर्श करें'
'कल का राशिफल' (tomorrow) is ambiguous because कल means both yesterday and tomorrow; the tab says 'आने वाला कल', so the heading could say 'आने वाले कल का राशिफल'

action_items: Charts.jsx: remove the letter-spacing on the South chart center label in Hindi mode
Wrap 'No city in the offline list.' and the loading texts in t() and add their Hindi
Translate the Kundli method line (map known parts or add one fixed Hindi sentence)
Fix the Hindi ordinals ({n}वें -> proper ordinal) and use '।' instead of '.' in Hindi sentences
critical_code_review_comments: Horoscope basisT regex /^(\w+) in house (\d+) from (\w+)$/ needs one-word planet and sign names. That works now, but the line would fall back to English if the backend ever changes its wording
Header/nav/bottom nav stay English in Hindi mode. This is expected because the scope only covers results

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; minor translation/typography leftovers)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Hindi mode verified with reference inputs (boy 1990-08-15 10:30 Varanasi, girl 1992-03-02 05:10 New Delhi). In Playwright, the chart toggles are not role=button. Use get_by_text('दक्षिण भारतीय', exact=True). Scope 'Why' buttons to article[data-testid^=horoscope-cat-] because the nav menu button also has aria-expanded.
